rows.text: The Cabinet Secretariat's list of the Council of Ministers with portfolios as on 25 July 2026 opens with Shri Narendra Modi as Prime Minister, also in charge of the Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions, the Departments of Atomic Energy and Space, all important policy issues and all portfolios not allocated to any Minister.
